tests.name: test_strict_top_three_per_category
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 7 AND MAX(sales_rank) = 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT (category, sales_rank)) = 7 AS ok FROM top_items

tests.name: test_units_aggregated_within_half_open_window
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN item_id = 1 THEN units_sold END) = 10 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_id IN (6, 7)) = 0 AND MAX(CASE WHEN item_id = 20 THEN units_sold END) = 3 AS ok FROM top_items

tests.name: test_top_items_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT category, item_id, units_sold, sales_rank FROM top_items), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, e3 FROM (VALUES ('a', 1, 10, 1), ('a', 2, 8, 2), ('a', 3, 8, 3), ('b', 10, 9, 1), ('b', 11, 7, 2), ('b', 12, 5, 3), ('c', 20, 3, 1)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok

tests.name: test_ties_skip_following_rank
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'a') = 3 AND MAX(CASE WHEN item_id = 3 THEN sales_rank END) = 2 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE item_id = 4) = 0 AS ok FROM top_items_with_ties

tests.name: test_tie_at_rank_three_keeps_all_tied_items
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'b' AND sales_rank = 3) = 2 AS ok FROM top_items_with_ties

tests.name: test_top_items_with_ties_exact
tests.query: WITH a AS (SELECT category, item_id, units_sold, sales_rank FROM top_items_with_ties), e AS (SELECT e0, e1, e2, e3 FROM (VALUES ('a', 1, 10, 1), ('a', 2, 8, 2), ('a', 3, 8, 2), ('b', 10, 9, 1), ('b', 11, 7, 2), ('b', 12, 5, 3), ('b', 13, 5, 3), ('c', 20, 3, 1)) v(e0, e1, e2, e3)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM a EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM e)) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM e EXCEPT ALL SELECT * FROM a)) = 0 AS ok
